about: Made-up voice messages to the in-app assistant (requests about interviews, candidates and settings), in all 23 interface languages (English three times), spoken by OpenAI's realtime speech model into datasets/audio/<id>.ogg (Ogg Opus, as browsers record) by build_audio.py, for the speech-to-text the assistant's microphone uses. Graded by code (`also`: other right ways to write it, such as digits for a number): character error rate against the text, and the language's script. Hand-written.
